Name: (AT) Nug the Fry Dragon and Friends
Author: CritMe20
Description:
[b]This is an Alternative Textures conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/Users/116667498]FreshHotFlavors.com[/url] mascot and mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8691]Nug the Fry Dragon[/url].

[/b]In order for this mod to work you need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] downloaded and added into your mods file.
There are seven new variations of Fry Dragons made by yours truly and as a new feature you can replace your dog with Nug too!
This mod [b]only[/b] changes the textures of your pets!

[u]Fry Dragon Variations
[/u]Nug the [i]original[/i] Fry Dragon
Purple Fry Dragon
Green Fry Dragon
Yellow Fry Dragon
Blue Fry Dragon
Light Blue Fry Dragon
White Fry Dragon
Black Fry Dragon
& As a special; a Rainbow Fry Dragon!
[i]Along with color some textures have unique variations!
[/i]
[b]Installation
[/b]1.Download and extract the files.
2.Put the main folder in "Mods".

[b]How to change textures
[/b]1. Purchase Scissors from Robin.
2. Use the Scissors tool to apply your chosen texture to entities, in this case your cat and/or dog.

For more information regarding Alternative Textures and its tools visit their mod site linked above!
[b]You can find a Content Patcher version of original Nug the Fry Dragon from FreshHotFlavors' own Nexusmods profile linked above![/b]
